action: Bring FortiOS to 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, 7.2.14 or 7.0.19, FortiManager to 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.12 or 7.2.13, and other listed products to the fixed releases in the advisory. Use the linked Fortinet PSIRT advisories to rank the work.
exec: A broad Fortinet patch set reaches firewalls, management tools and endpoint clients; no exploitation is reported in the Canadian advisory.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told organisations using Fortinet firewalls, management consoles, email and remote-access software to install a large set of security updates.

key_findings: The advisory lists Fortinet vulnerabilities as of November 11, 2026 across 15 product lines.
FortiOS is affected before 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, 7.2.14 and 7.0.19; FortiManager before 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.12 and 7.2.13.
FortiAnalyzer is affected before 8.0.3, 7.6.8, 7.4.8 and 7.2.12; FortiMail before 8.0.3, 7.6.7, 7.4.9, 7.2.13 and 7.0.7.
Also listed: FortiAuthenticator, FortiClient for Windows, Mac and EMS, FortiPAM Chrome Extension, FortiSandbox, FortiSASE and FortiSIEM.
The page names no CVEs and makes no statement about exploitation.
recommendations: Review the Fortinet PSIRT advisories linked from the advisory.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

summary: Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1145 lists Fortinet vulnerabilities as of November 11 across 15 product lines, among them FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail, FortiAuthenticator, FortiClient, FortiSandbox, FortiSASE and FortiSIEM. It gives the fixed release for each branch, for example FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, 7.2.14 and 7.0.19. The page names no CVEs and does not say whether any flaw is being exploited.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues Fortinet advisory AV26-1145 covering 15 product lines

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Canadian Centre for Cyber Security document.

review.note: Compared 15 product lines, as-of date, FortiOS and FortiManager fixed versions against CCCS AV26-1145
